title: Thrusty Reentry Vehicle / Glide Body
description: Canonical format for an independently-loadable reentry vehicle (mirrors RVParams / rv_from_dict; stored as rv_library/<name>.rv.json). RVs are shared: a missile attaches one via payload.rv_ref. NOTE: satellites that do not reenter are NOT RVs — they are modelled as an orbital payload on the missile (payload.terminal_mode = 'orbital'), with no entry here.

rv_kind.description: Discriminator. ballistic → separating_rv, glider off (mass_kg required). marv_body → separation_mode='body': mass_kg/diameter_m/length_m are INHERITED from the missile's last-stage burnout state, so their absence here is correct, NOT a gap. glider → glider_enabled, requires glider_LD + glider_guidance. decoy → light, low-β separating object.

mass_kg.description: kg — single-RV mass. Required for ballistic/glider/decoy; ignored (inherited) for marv_body.

beta_kg_m2.description: kg/m² — ballistic coefficient m/(Cd·A). The one always-required physics field. Prefer a given value; geometry derivation is low-confidence (hypersonic Cd is uncertain).

nose_radius_m.description: m — stagnation radius for Sutton-Graves heating. Default 0.05 (filled silently).

glider_guidance.description: Glide-guidance mode (all dynamic-EOM modes couple drag to commanded lift — no free lift). 'skip_glide' (ζ=0, undamped phugoid). 'damped_glide' (α* lift + ζ damping ratio → decaying skips; ζ=0 ≡ skip_glide, larger ζ → fewer skips). 'dynamic_equilibrium_glide' (equilibrium-trim nominal + ζ tracking gain → SMOOTH capture, no oscillation). 'equilibrium_glide_acton' (Acton analytic non-oscillatory capture). 'equilibrium_glide' (Tracy analytic steady glide) and 'skip_to_equilibrium' (skip then auto-handoff). Dynamic modes plunge an uncapturable (lofted) entry; analytic modes always capture. See DAMPED_GLIDE.md / GLIDE_CAPTURE_DESIGN.md.

glider_beta_entry_kg_m2.description: Acton Phase-3 direct-reentry β_S. Required ONLY for glider_guidance='equilibrium_glide_acton'.

glider_damping_zeta.description: damped_glide only; target phugoid damping ratio ζ. Default 0.7. ζ=0 is bit-identical to skip_glide; large ζ → equilibrium glide.
